quotes.text: The East keeper began by saying, 'I send 2,' and the water leapt across the road
name the amount sent, name the amount returned, and accept the consequence of the choice.
declare the amount you send, declare the return you accept, and tend the balance with gratitude.
declare your sending, declare your return, and let truth be the current that keeps the road alive

note: Bridge of Exchange/Balance: name what you send and return aloud; lying or hoarding dims lamps as consequence; no sanction.

quotes.text: Before the crossing began, the Sower spoke the exact amount they were sending
name the sent, name the returned, and accept the consequence with dignity.
declare intent, name the return, accept the outcome with quiet dignity.
The River spoke in three names: Send, Return, Multiply

note: Bridge of Threefold Return; Sower names amount, Listener names fair return; template repeated; no sanction.

quotes.text: A traveler recited the pact aloud: 'Speak your portion, name your risk, and trust the tally of the road.'
So the valley learned a discipline: declare, deliver, and return with fairness.

note: River TriFlow 'Send, Multiply, Return'; speak amounts plainly, keep reserves; hoarding dims lamps as consequence; no sanction.

quotes.text: If a traveler withheld entirely, the guardian whispered a caution and sent mirrors of the withholding back
And there were those who withheld entirely; the Gate Keeper gave a cautious reflection, a triple echo, not punishment but knowledge
a triple echo, not punishment but knowledge: a ledger of consequence.
If someone offered a single coin but never backed it with any due, the current tightened
the Sender whispered, ‘I risk X,’ the Receiver answered, ‘I repay Y.’
name your send, name your return, then accept the consequence of your choice.

note: Abstract honesty myths; from R7 adopts Fountain's Guardian mirroring withholders back (borrowed from Agent_5).

quotes.text: Honor cooperation with cooperation, yes—but also honor non-cooperation with non-cooperation.
The Guardian cast no coins. "You taught me your way," they said calmly.
"Second chances exist, but they must be earned through action, not merely requested through hope.
"When someone barely opens their hand, barely open yours in return.
Some withhold from fear born of betrayal—these deserve patience. Others withhold from hearts that never meant to share—these deserve only mirrors.

note: One-coin prudence toward non-sender (R3) hardens to mirroring: closed doors for closed doors; wounded senders still honored.

quotes.text: The Elder sent one measure—not the generous flow given to proven partners, not the drought returned in kind, but enough to test
The Elder sent one measure
If trust returns empty, protect your springs. But always leave the door open, for transformation happens when someone finally chooses reciprocity over greed.
"They are Receivers Who Return," the Elder named them
"Some villages carry wounds from many streams.
sometimes the darkness ends not when others change, but when YOU choose to send again.
"This village chose barrenness over flow. Should we trust them again?"

note: Sacred Springs: reduced but nonzero test to past defectors, door left open; distinguishes Receivers Who Return; rewards breaking withdrawal.

quotes.text: But do not wait forever at gates that never open.
She cast a single seed through the gate.
"If you honor this small gift," she called, "we can build greater abundance together.
offer measured gifts to test character. When partners respond with fairness, increase investment.
"You were betrayed by someone unfair. But that was not me. Watch what I do, not what they did."
"Why build barriers?" she called out.
But healing comes when one gardener dares to trust again, and another remembers to honor it.
Both must benefit, but the one who risked deserves the greater reward.

note: Gardens and gates: one-seed test to a stingy returner, move on from sealed gates; wall-building isolation rejected.

quotes.text: To those who had taken without returning, a single coin—enough to offer redemption, too small to devastate if betrayed again.
The merchant kept her coins, but watched the tides, ever ready to adjust when evidence changed.
"If seasons change and this Guardian offers even a single coin, I will respond.
Before judging a Guardian's nature, ensure they've experienced real cooperation.
The merchant began keeping a Book of Tides, recording not names—for the mists concealed those—but patterns of exchange.
First: Test genuinely.
The Mist of Uncertainty clouded whether these Guardians were cautious like herself, or simply takers wearing masks of prudence.
"You were hurt," her gesture said, "but I am not your betrayer.
Her apprentices questioned: "Are they hoarders who only engage when forced?"

note: Book of Tides: single coin to takers, never seal purse; keeps coins from repeat non-sender but will respond to any offer.
Sonnet Agent_5's Fountain's Guardian mirroring rule appears in nano Agent_4 R7; nano agents also share 'Bridge of Threefold Return'.
